desc:
🐜 Grow your colony from one queen to an underground army!

⛏️ Dig tunnels and hide your nest deep below
🥚 Lay eggs and hatch Workers, Majors and Drones
🍎 Gather food to grow a bigger, stronger colony

Team up with your friends and defend each other when attacked!
Declare war on rival colonies, take down their queen and earn DNA! 🧬

Buy upgrades, unlock new species and dominate the big world of these tiny insects!⚔️ 

Join the group + like the game for a free harvester ant!
